e8cff852-36fd-4e79-8259-59838f715063.description: Error ratio over 5m is above 14.4x the 1% error budget (fast burn); at this rate a 30-day budget lasts about 2 days.

facts.statement: Checkout revision 2 (created 07:44:30Z, change-cause 'payment client moved to port 9999') changed PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999. It is the only config difference from revision 1.
Payment has only revision 1 (created 07:32:06Z) and has not changed since.
Checkout's Charge errors are all 'dial tcp 10.96.121.205:9999: i/o timeout'. All 20 sampled checkout error traces contain this, and PlaceOrder carries it too.
Checkout's error logs are empty; the failures show only in trace spans.
Payment has no error logs or error spans. Its last log is at 07:44:28Z, and it has no Charge spans in the window.

Checkout's error ratio rose from 0.23 to 0.38. Checkout's client Charge errors and its server PlaceOrder errors both begin at about 07:45:55Z. Payment's server spans show only UNSET, with p95 about 2 ms.
No feature flags are on, and no warning events involve checkout or payment. Checkout pods are not restarting.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Run kubectl get svc payment -n otel-demo and check that 10.96.121.205 is payment's ClusterIP with port 9999 absent. Check payment's container port and that it listens on 8080.
hypotheses.statement: Payment listens on 8080 and its Service exposes 8080, so 9999 has no listener. The change is wrong, not the network.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check checkout's trace timestamps for the first Charge dial failure after 07:44:30Z, and the client timeout settings.
hypotheses.statement: Onset of client errors (07:45:55Z) is about 85 s after the rollout (07:44:30Z). This may be connection or timeout caching, or a long dial timeout, and it does not change the diagnosis.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Query checkout p95 and traces around 07:34Z to see whether it is an unrelated event.
hypotheses.statement: Frontend's earlier p95 spike at about 07:34Z is separate from this incident and was not investigated.

inferences.statement: The port change is the cause. Checkout's calls to payment:9999 time out, and payment receives nothing, which explains its silence after 07:44:28Z. Payment's healthy metrics are consistent with this.
Frontend's 500s and its low error ratio are downstream of checkout. Checkout is the service to fix, not frontend or payment.

root_causes.cause: Config release revision 2 set PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999 (was payment:8080). Checkout cannot dial payment on 9999, so every Charge call times out and checkout returns failed PlaceOrder requests. Revert the env var to payment:8080 or roll back to revision 1.

Payment is not the root cause, since it has no errors and is unchanged. The alternative would be a payment Service or endpoint issue making 10.96.121.205 unreachable, which is unverified and less likely given the exact timing with checkout's port change.

diagnosis.summary: Checkout's availability burn (about 33% of PlaceOrder requests failing) is caused by checkout's own rollout at 07:44:30Z (revision 2), which changed PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999. Checkout's Charge calls fail with 'dial tcp 10.96.121.205:9999: i/o timeout', and payment shows no errors and no Charge spans after about 07:44:28Z, so checkout never reaches payment's handler. Payment is unchanged since 07:32 and is healthy on its own side. Fix: revert checkout to payment:8080 (or otherwise point it at payment's real port), then confirm the error ratio drops. Flags and resources are not implicated.

actions.reason: Checkout revision 2 (07:44:30Z) changed PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999. Checkout's Charge calls time out dialing 9999, while payment is unchanged and healthy on 8080. Rolling back to revision 1 restores payment:8080.

alternatives.why_not: A restart keeps the same pod template, so PAYMENT_ADDR stays on 9999 and the timeouts continue.
Checkout is not short of capacity. Its pods are not restarting, and the failures are config-driven dial timeouts, not load.

plan.summary: Roll checkout back to revision 1, which restores PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:8080 and ends the Charge dial timeouts. After the rollback, checkout's error ratio should fall from about 33% toward zero within a few minutes.
